subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth - clarifying questions
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Thompson <ben@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>; Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - next steps

Hi Ben —

Great to meet earlier today. Per our call, we can start the vendor security questionnaire so your InfoSec team can review Redwood's controls. To summarize the ask:

- You indicated AcmeHealth prefers the SIG profile (standard) but can accept a CAIQ export if helpful.
- You're primarily focused on SOC 2 status (in-scope systems and date of last audit), data residency, and HIPAA/GDPR handling for PHI/PII.
- Timeline target: security review completed by end of May if possible.

Next steps from our side: I'll attach our latest SIG workbook and a redacted network diagram. Please confirm which format works best for you (SIG.xlsx vs CAIQ JSON) and whether your team wants a short follow-up call to walk through any high-risk items.

Attached: SIG.xlsx (spreadsheet export of SIG), Network-Diagram.pdf (redacted).

If you can reply with a single point of contact for the questionnaire and any additional documents you need (e.g., encryption key management evidence, SOC 2 report PDF), we'll prioritize those items.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Ben Thompson <ben@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Sofia Lopez <sofia.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - next steps

Camila —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the attachments. A couple of clarifying questions before we circulate to InfoSec: 

1) SOC 2: Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent 12-month period? If yes, can you provide the report PDF and the auditor name?
2) HIPAA: Will AcmeHealth be treated as a Business Associate under your processing agreement? We need confirmation of a BAA or equivalent.
3) Data residency: Can you confirm whether production customer data that may include PHI is stored in us-west-2 only, or replicated cross-region?
4) SIG format: SIG.xlsx is fine. If you have a CAIQ JSON export that speeds mapping in our tooling, we'd accept that too.

Point of contact for us: Sofia Lopez (Sofia.Lopez@acmehealth.com) — she'll own the security packet review.

Appreciate it — if we can get the SOC 2 PDF and a BAA confirmation, we can start the internal review today.

Ben
Ben Thompson
Director, Security Operations
AcmeHealth

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Thompson <ben@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Sofia Lopez <sofia.lopez@acmehealth.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - next steps

Hi Ben / Sofia —

Thanks — quick answers inline and attached the requested items: 

1) SOC 2: Yes, we have a SOC 2 Type II audit for the period 2026-06-01 to 2027-05-31. Auditor: Stonebridge Audit LLP. I've attached the redacted SOC 2 report PDF (redacted to remove customer-specific identifiers).
2) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood offers a standard BAA for customers processing PHI. We're happy to execute a BAA with AcmeHealth. Legal prefers to review the mutual terms; I can connect our counsel if you want edits.
3) Data residency: Production data is stored in us-west-2 by default. We replicate logs to us-east-1 for analytics, but PHI payloads are not replicated outside us-west-2 unless customers opt into cross-region failover. I'll attach our data residency FAQ excerpt.
4) SIG format: Attached SIG.xlsx. Also included a CAIQ JSON export in case your mapping tool prefers that format (file: SIG-caiq.json).

Attachments included: SIG.xlsx; SOC2-Redacted.pdf; Data-Residency-FAQ.pdf; SIG-caiq.json

If Sofia wants a short 30-minute walkthrough of the high-risk controls, Marissa (cc'd) can join to cover encryption and key management. Proposed times: Wed 12 May 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu 13 May 14:00-14:30 PT. Let me know what works.

Best,
Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Lopez <sofia.lopez@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood-inference.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - next steps

Thanks Camila — received and this looks great.

We reviewed the SOC 2 and the SIG workbook and have three quick follow-ups: 

- Can you confirm whether customer-managed keys (CMK) are supported via KMS/HSM integrations for at-rest encryption? If so, which cloud KMS providers are supported?
- For the network diagram, can you call out any third-party managed services or subcontractors that have access to the production environment (e.g., monitoring vendors)?
- Do you have a copy of the BAA template we can start with? Emailing legal now — if we see edits we'll circle back.

We can do the walkthrough tomorrow 13 May at 14:00 PT. Sofia will send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sofia Lopez
Senior Information Security Manager
AcmeHealth
sofia.lopez@acmehealth.com
